en.s: The Battle of Khazir (Arabic: يوم الخازر, romanized: Yawm Khāzir) took place in August 686 near the Khazir River in Mosul's eastern environs, in modern-day Iraq. The battle occurred during the Second Fitna between the Syria-based Umayyad Caliphate and the Kufa-based pro-Alid forces under Mukhtar al-Thaqafi. It ended with the Umayyad forces being routed and resulted in the expansion of Mukhtar's rule into the Mosul region.

zh.s: 卡齐尔河战役发生于686年8月，地点在摩苏尔东郊的卡齐尔河附近（今伊拉克境内）。这是第二次伊斯兰内战期间，叙利亚的倭马亚哈里发国与以库法为据点、支持阿里后裔的穆赫塔尔·萨卡菲军队之间的一场战斗。倭马亚军被击溃，穆赫塔尔的势力也因此扩展到摩苏尔地区。

en.s: The Battle of Sunomata-gawa (墨俣川の戦い Sunomata-gawa no Tatakai) took place in Japan on 6 August 1181 (or by the Japanese calendar, Jishō-5 year, 4-month, 25-day), in the present-day town of Sunomata, Gifu Prefecture. The battle started when Minamoto no Yukiie attempted a sneak attack against his enemies during the night. He found Taira no Tomomori and his army directly opposite from his, along the Sunomata River, near the borders of Owari and Mino provinces. The Minamoto warriors waded across, but their ambush failed when the Taira clan could distinguish dry friend from soaking, dripping wet foe, even in the pitch dark of night.

zh.s: 墨俣川之战（日语：墨俣川の戦い，Sunomata-gawa no Tatakai）于1181年8月6日在日本爆发（按日本历为治承5年4月25日），地点在今岐阜县墨俣町。夜间，源行家试图偷袭敌军，却发现平氏的平知盛及其军队就在墨俣川对岸，靠近尾张国与美浓国的边界。源氏武士涉水渡河，但突袭失败：平氏即使在漆黑夜色中，也能分辨出身上干燥的己方士兵和浑身湿透、滴水的敌军。

en.s: The Battle of Meloria was fought near the islet of Meloria in the Ligurian Sea on 5 and 6 August 1284 between the fleets of the Republics of Genoa and Pisa as part of the Genoese-Pisan War. The victory of Genoa and the destruction of the Pisan fleet marked the decline of the Republic of Pisa.

zh.s: 梅洛里亚海战于1284年8月5日至6日在利古里亚海的梅洛里亚小岛附近爆发，交战双方是热那亚共和国和比萨共和国的舰队，属于热那亚—比萨战争的一部分。热那亚获胜并摧毁比萨舰队，标志着比萨共和国开始衰落。

en.s: The Battle of Kinghorn was fought on 6 August 1332 at Wester Kinghorn (now Burntisland), Fife, Scotland. An invading seaborne force of 1,500 men was commanded by Edward Balliol and Henry Beaumont, Earl of Buchan. A Scottish army, possibly 4,000 strong, commanded by Duncan, Earl of Fife, and Robert Bruce, Lord of Liddesdale (an illegitimate son of King Robert the Bruce) was defeated with heavy loss.

zh.s: 金霍恩战役于1332年8月6日在苏格兰法夫郡西金霍恩（今伯恩蒂斯兰）爆发。入侵的海上部队有1,500人，由爱德华·巴利奥尔和布肯伯爵亨利·博蒙特率领。苏格兰军队可能有4,000人，由法夫伯爵邓肯和利德斯代尔领主罗伯特·布鲁斯（苏格兰国王罗伯特一世的私生子）指挥，但在战斗中惨败，伤亡惨重。

en.s: The Second War of Scottish Independence broke out in 1332, when Edward Balliol led an English-backed invasion of Scotland. Balliol, the son of former Scottish king John Balliol, was attempting to make good his claim to the Scottish throne. He was opposed by Scots loyal to the occupant of the throne, eight-year-old David II. At the Battle of Dupplin Moor Balliol's force defeated a Scottish army ten times their size and Balliol was crowned king.

zh.t: 第二次苏格兰独立战争
zh.s: 第二次苏格兰独立战争于1332年爆发，当时爱德华·巴里奥尔率领英格兰支持的军队入侵苏格兰。巴里奥尔是前苏格兰国王约翰·巴里奥尔之子，试图实现自己对苏格兰王位的要求。反对他的是效忠在位国王、年仅8岁的苏格兰国王大卫二世的军队。在杜普林沼泽战役中，巴里奥尔的部队击败了兵力为己方十倍的苏格兰军队，巴里奥尔随后加冕为王。

en.s: The Polish–Lithuanian–Teutonic War, also known as the Great Teutonic War, occurred between 1409 and 1411 between the Teutonic Knights and the allied Kingdom of Poland and Grand Duchy of Lithuania. Inspired by the local Samogitian uprising, the war began with a Teutonic invasion of Poland in August 1409. As neither side was ready for a full-scale war, Wenceslaus IV of Bohemia brokered a nine-month truce.

zh.s: 波兰—立陶宛—条顿战争也称大条顿战争，于1409年至1411年间在条顿骑士团与波兰王国、立陶宛大公国的联盟之间爆发。受当地萨莫吉希亚人起义影响，战争于1409年8月以条顿骑士团入侵波兰开始。由于双方都未准备好全面开战，波希米亚国王瓦茨拉夫四世斡旋达成九个月停战。

en.t: Bogotá, Colombia, is founded by Gonzalo Jiménez de Quesada
en.s: Bogotá (, also UK: , US: , Spanish pronunciation: [boɣoˈta] ) is the capital and largest city of Colombia. The city is administered as the Capital District, as well as the capital of, though not politically part of, the surrounding department of Cundinamarca. Bogotá is a territorial entity of the first order, with the same administrative status as the departments of Colombia.

zh.t: 哥伦比亚波哥大由贡萨洛·希门尼斯·德克萨达建立
zh.s: 波哥大是哥伦比亚首都和最大城市，西班牙语读音为[boɣoˈta]。波哥大以首都特区形式管理，也是周边昆迪纳马卡省的首府，但在政治上不属于该省。波哥大是一级行政区划单位，行政地位与哥伦比亚各省相同。

en.s: The siege of Castelnuovo was an engagement during the Ottoman-Habsburg struggle for control of the Mediterranean, which took place in July 1539 at the walled town of Castelnuovo, present-day Herceg Novi, Montenegro. Castelnuovo had been conquered by elements of various Spanish tercios the year before during the failed campaign of the Holy League against the Ottoman Empire in Eastern Mediterranean waters.

en.t: Toyotomi Hideyoshi is officially appointed kampaku (Imperial Regent)
en.s: Toyotomi Hideyoshi (豊臣 秀吉; Japanese pronunciation: [to.jo.to.mʲi (|) çi.de(ꜜ).jo.ɕi], 16 February 1537 – 18 September 1598), otherwise known as Kinoshita Tōkichirō (木下 藤吉郎) and Hashiba Hideyoshi (羽柴 秀吉), was a Japanese samurai and daimyō (feudal lord) of the late Sengoku and Azuchi-Momoyama periods, regarded as the second "Great Unifier" of Japan.

zh.t: 丰臣秀吉正式获任关白（摄政）
zh.s: 丰臣秀吉（豊臣 秀吉；日语读音：[to.jo.to.mʲi (|) çi.de(ꜜ).jo.ɕi]；1537年2月16日—1598年9月18日），另称木下藤吉郎（木下 藤吉郎）和羽柴秀吉（羽柴 秀吉），是日本战国时代末期及安土桃山时代的武士和大名，被视为日本第二位“天下统一者”。

en.s: The Battle of Stadtlohn was fought on 6 August 1623 between the armies of Christian of Brunswick and of the Catholic League during the Thirty Years' War. The League's forces were led by Johann Tserclaes, Count of Tilly.

en.s: The Ruin (Ukrainian: Руїна, romanized: Ruyina) is a historical term introduced by the Cossack chronicle writer Samiilo Velychko (1670–1728) for the political situation in Ukrainian history during the second half of the 17th century. The timeframe of the period varies among historians: Some historians such as Mykola Kostomarov define the period between 1663 and 1687, associating it with the three Moscow-appointed hetmans of Left-bank Ukraine (Briukhovetsky, Mnohohrishny and Samoylovych).

zh.s: “废墟时期”（乌克兰语：Руїна，转写：Ruyina）是一个历史术语，由哥萨克编年史作者萨米伊洛·韦利奇科（1670—1728年）提出，指17世纪下半叶乌克兰的政治局势。历史学家对这一时期的时间范围看法不一：例如，米科拉·科斯托马罗夫等人将其界定为1663年至1687年，并将之与莫斯科任命的三位左岸乌克兰盖特曼（布留霍韦茨基、姆诺霍里什尼和萨莫伊洛维奇）联系起来。

en.s: The Treaty of The Hague (also known as the Treaty of Den Haag) was signed on 6 August 1661 between representatives of the Dutch Republic and Portugal. Based on the terms of the treaty, the Dutch Republic recognized Portuguese sovereignty over New Holland (Dutch Brazil) in exchange for an indemnity of 4 million reis, conversion from 2 million caroli guilders, over the span of 16 years.

zh.s: 《海牙条约》又称《登海尔德条约》，于1661年8月6日由荷兰共和国和葡萄牙的代表签署。根据条约，荷兰共和国承认葡萄牙对新荷兰（荷属巴西）的主权，作为交换，葡萄牙将在16年内支付400万雷伊斯的赔款，折合200万卡罗利盾。

en.s: The siege of Santa Maura took place on 21 July – 6 August 1684 between the forces of the Republic of Venice and the Ottoman Empire, and was the opening battle of the Sixth Ottoman–Venetian War. From his base at Corfu the Venetian commander-in-chief, Francesco Morosini, led a fleet of 38 galleys, 8 galleasses and several auxiliary vessels to besiege the Fortress of Santa Maura on the island of Lefkada (also known as Santa Maura), that was under Ottoman rule.

zh.s: 圣马韦拉围城战于1684年7月21日至8月6日爆发，交战双方是威尼斯共和国和奥斯曼帝国。这是第六次奥斯曼—威尼斯战争的首场战役。威尼斯海军总司令弗朗切斯科·莫罗西尼从科孚岛基地出发，率领一支舰队围攻圣马韦拉要塞。舰队包括38艘桨帆船、8艘大型帆桨船和数艘辅助船只。要塞位于奥斯曼帝国统治下的莱夫卡达岛（又称圣马韦拉岛）。

en.s: The Siege of Gaeta was a siege during the War of Polish Succession fought at Gaeta, Italy. The Habsburgs at Gaeta withstood four months of siege from the Bourbon armies under the Duke of Parma (the future Charles III of Spain). They were defeated on 6 August 1734 when the Spanish and French stormed the city. Twenty-seven years earlier, Austrian troops under Count Wirich Philipp von Daun had laid siege to Gaeta during the War of the Spanish Succession. The Jacobite pretender Charles Edward Stuart was present for a time as an observer, his first exposure to war.

zh.s: 加埃塔围城战是波兰王位继承战争期间发生在意大利加埃塔的一场围城战。哈布斯堡军队在城内抵抗了帕尔马公爵（后来的西班牙国王卡洛斯三世）率领的波旁军队，坚守了四个月。1734年8月6日，西班牙和法国军队攻入城中，守军被击败。27年前，西班牙王位继承战争期间，维里希·菲利普·冯·道恩伯爵率领奥地利军队也曾围攻加埃塔。詹姆斯党王位觊觎者查尔斯·爱德华·斯图亚特曾以观察员身份在场一段时间，这是他首次接触战争。

en.s: The Battle of Oriskany ( or ) was a major engagement of the Saratoga campaign during the American Revolutionary War. On August 6, 1777, an American column of Tryon County militia and Oneidas marching to relieve the siege of Fort Stanwix was ambushed by a contingent of Britain's Indigenous allies and Loyalists. It was one of the few battles of the war in which most non-Indigenous participants were settlers born in the Thirteen Colonies.

zh.s: 奥里斯卡尼战役是美国独立战争萨拉托加战役中的一场重要交战。1777年8月6日，特赖恩县民兵和奥奈达族人组成的美军纵队前往解围斯坦威克斯堡，途中遭到英国的原住民盟友和效忠派武装伏击。这是独立战争中少数几场非原住民参战者多数为十三殖民地本土出生居民的战斗之一。

en.s: The Battle of Hanging Rock (August 6, 1780) was a battle in the American Revolutionary War that occurred between the American Patriots and the British. It was part of a campaign by militia General Thomas Sumter to harass or destroy British outposts in the South Carolina backcountry that had been established after the fall of Charleston in May 1780.

zh.s: 悬岩战役于1780年8月6日爆发，是美国独立战争期间美国爱国者与英国军队之间的一场战斗。该战役属于托马斯·萨姆特民兵将军发起的一场军事行动，旨在骚扰或摧毁查尔斯顿于1780年5月陷落后，英国在南卡罗来纳州腹地建立的前哨据点。

en.s: The Constitution of the United States is the supreme law of the United States of America. It superseded the Articles of Confederation, the nation's first constitution, on March 4, 1789. Originally including seven articles, the Constitution defined the foundational structure of the federal government. The drafting of the Constitution by many of the nation's Founding Fathers, often referred to as its framing, was completed at the Constitutional Convention, which assembled at Independence Hall in Philadelphia between May 25 and September 17, 1787.
en.n: Sixty proof sheets of the Constitution of the United States are delivered to the Constitutional Convention in Philadelphia, Pennsylvania.

zh.s: 美国宪法是美利坚合众国的最高法律，于1789年3月4日取代美国的第一部宪法《邦联条例》。宪法最初包含七条，规定了联邦政府的基本架构。美国开国元勋在宪法会议期间起草宪法，该会议于1787年5月25日至9月17日在费城独立厅举行。

en.s: Francis II and I (German: Franz II; 12 February 1768 – 2 March 1835) was the last Holy Roman Emperor as Francis II from 1792 to 1806, and the first Emperor of Austria as Francis I from 1804 to 1835. en.s: The Holy Roman Empire, also known as the Holy Roman Empire of the German Nation after 1512, was a polity comprising and controlling much of Central Europe and Western Europe, headed by the Holy Roman Emperor and characterized by a decentralized political structure. It developed in the Early Middle Ages (beginning in either 800 or 962), and lasted for a millennium until its dissolution in 1806 during the Napoleonic Wars.

zh.s: 神圣罗马帝国自1512年起也称德意志民族神圣罗马帝国，是一个涵盖并控制中欧和西欧大片地区的政体，由神圣罗马帝国皇帝统治，政治结构高度分散。帝国在中世纪早期形成（起始年份有800年或962年两种说法），延续约一千年，最终于1806年拿破仑战争期间解体。

en.s: The Battle of Rakkestad was fought in the Swedish–Norwegian War of 1814, at the village of Rakkestad, Norway, between 2,000–3,000 Swedes force under Eberhard von Vegesack, and a slightly smaller Norwegian force, led by Frederik Wilhelm Stabell. The Swedish forces drove the Norwegians back from their fortified positions with a disciplined bayonet-attack and dealt them considerable losses.

zh.s: 1814年瑞典—挪威战争期间，瑞典军队在挪威拉克斯塔德村与挪威军交战。瑞军由埃伯哈德·冯·韦格萨克率领，兵力为2000至3000人；挪威军兵力略少，由弗雷德里克·威廉·斯塔贝尔率领。瑞军以有组织的刺刀冲锋击退挪军，迫使其离开防御阵地并造成较大损失。

en.t: Norwich University is founded in Vermont as the first private military school in the United States
en.s: Norwich University is a private university in Northfield, Vermont, United States. The university was founded in 1819 as the "American Literary, Scientific and Military Academy". zh.s: 沃尔特战役又称赖希斯霍芬战役或弗勒施维莱尔战役，指1870年8月6日普法战争初期爆发的第二次沃尔特战役。（第一次沃尔特战役发生于1793年12月23日，属于拿破仑战争。）第二次战役中，德国军队由腓特烈王储指挥、参谋长莱昂哈德·格拉夫·冯·布卢门塔尔将军督战，在阿尔萨斯的沃尔特村附近、索尔河畔，击败了麦克马洪元帅率领的法军。沃尔特位于阿格诺以北10公里。

en.s: The Battle of Spicheren (also known as the Battle of Forbach) was fought on 6 August 1870 during the Franco-Prussian War. German forces won a victory compelled the French to withdraw to the defenses of Metz. The battle was the second of three critical French defeats.

zh.s: 施皮谢朗战役又称福尔巴克战役，于1870年8月6日普法战争期间爆发。德军获胜，迫使法军撤往梅斯防线。该战役是法国连续三场重大失利中的第二场。

en.t: At Auburn Prison in New York, murderer William Kemmler becomes the first person to be executed by electric chair
en.s: William Francis Kemmler (May 9, 1860 – August 6, 1890) was an American murderer who was the first person executed by electric chair. He was convicted of murdering Matilda "Tillie" Ziegler, his common-law wife, a year earlier. Although electrocution had previously been successfully used to kill a horse, Kemmler's execution did not go smoothly.

zh.t: 威廉·凯姆勒在奥本监狱被电椅处决
zh.s: 威廉·弗朗西斯·凯姆勒（1860年5月9日—1890年8月6日）是一名美国杀人犯，也是首位被电椅处决的人。他因谋杀事实婚姻妻子玛蒂尔达·“蒂莉”·齐格勒而被定罪；谋杀案发生在处决前一年。此前，人们曾成功用电刑杀死一匹马，但凯姆勒的处决过程并不顺利。

en.s: The 1900 Alabama gubernatorial election took place on August 6, 1900, in order to elect the governor of Alabama. Incumbent Democrat Joseph F. Johnston decided not to run for a third term in office. For the last time, the Governor of Alabama was elected to a two-year term. Afterwards, Alabama governors would be elected for terms of four years.

en.s: The Battle of Yangcun was a battle during the march of Eight-Nation Alliance forces from Tianjin to Beijing during the Boxer Rebellion. The Alliance forces defeated the Qing and were able to continue their march towards Peking.

zh.s: 义和团运动期间，八国联军从天津向北京进军途中爆发杨村战役。联军击败清军，得以继续向北京推进。

en.s: The 1904 Reading by-election was a Parliamentary by-election held on 6 August 1904. The constituency returned one Member of Parliament (MP) to the House of Commons of the United Kingdom, elected by the first past the post voting system.

zh.s: 1904年雷丁选区补选于1904年8月6日举行。这一英国下议院选区选出一名国会议员（MP），采用领先者当选的简单多数制。

en.s: The 1904 New South Wales state election was held on 6 August 1904 for all of the 90 seats in the 20th New South Wales Legislative Assembly and it was conducted in single-member constituencies with a first past the post voting system. For the first time, women were entitled to vote. Both adult males and females were entitled to vote, but not Indigenous people.

zh.s: 1904年新南威尔士州选举于1904年8月6日举行，选出新南威尔士州第20届立法议会的全部90名议员。选举采用单一选区制和简单多数制。这是女性首次获得投票权；成年男性和女性均可投票，但原住民除外。

en.s: The 1906–07 United States Senate elections were held on various dates in various states. As these U.S. Senate elections were prior to the ratification of the Seventeenth Amendment in 1913, senators were chosen by state legislatures. Senators were elected over a wide range of time throughout 1906 and 1907, and a seat may have been filled months late or remained vacant due to legislative deadlock.

en.s: Presidential elections were held in Portugal on 6 August 1915. Following Portugal's 1911 constitution, the Congress of the Republic must elect the president in Lisbon instead of the Portuguese people. There were a total of seven candidates. One of the Democratic Party candidates, Bernardino Machado won against his opponents and he was elected as the new President of Portugal.

zh.s: 葡萄牙于1915年8月6日举行总统选举。根据葡萄牙1911年宪法，总统必须由共和国国会在里斯本选出，而不是由民众投票产生。共有7名候选人。民主党候选人之一贝尔纳迪诺·马沙多击败其他对手，当选葡萄牙新总统。

en.s: The 1915 Manitoba general election was held August 6, 1915 to elect members of the Legislative Assembly of the Province of Manitoba, Canada. Liberals under Norris took a slight majority of votes and won a landslide majority in the Legislature. They replaced the Conservative government that had ruled the province since 1899 but had lost power after investigation for corruption.

zh.s: 1915年曼尼托巴省大选于1915年8月6日举行，选出加拿大曼尼托巴省立法议会议员。诺里斯领导的自由党以微弱优势赢得多数选票，却在议会中取得压倒性多数。他们取代了自1899年以来执政的保守党政府；该政府因腐败调查失去执政地位。

en.s: The Attack of the Dead Men, or the Battle of Osowiec Fortress, was a battle of World War I that took place at Osowiec Fortress (in present-day northeastern Poland), at 4:00 AM on August 6, 1915. The incident received its grim name from the bloodied, corpse-like appearance of the Russian combatants after German artillery had bombarded them with a mixture of poison gases, chlorine and bromine.

zh.s: “死尸攻击”又称奥索维茨要塞战役，是第一次世界大战期间发生在奥索维茨要塞的一场战斗。要塞位于今波兰东北部，战斗于1915年8月6日凌晨4时爆发。德国炮兵使用氯气、溴等毒气混合物轰击俄军，俄军士兵满身血污、形如尸体，因此这场战斗得名。

en.s: The Battle of Sari Bair (Turkish: Sarı Bayır Harekâtı), also known as the August Offensive (Ağustos Taarruzları), represented the final attempt made by the British in August 1915 to seize control of the Gallipoli peninsula from the Ottoman Empire during the First World War. At the time of the battle, the Gallipoli Campaign had raged on two fronts – Anzac and Helles – for three months since the Allied land invasion of 25 April 1915.
en.n: World War I: Battle of Sari Bair: The Allies mount a diversionary attack timed to coincide with a major Allied landing of reinforcements at Suvla Bay.

zh.s: 萨里拜尔战役（土耳其语：Sarı Bayır Harekâtı）又称“八月攻势”（Ağustos Taarruzları），是第一次世界大战期间英国军队于1915年8月夺取加里波利半岛、赶走奥斯曼帝国的最后一次尝试。当时，加里波利战役已在安扎克和赫勒斯两条战线上持续三个月；协约国于1915年4月25日登陆。
zh.n: 第一次世界大战：萨里拜尔战役：协约国发动佯攻，以配合在苏夫拉湾大规模登陆增援部队。

en.s: The Battle of Doberdò took place near Doberdò del Lago (Slovene: Doberdob) in August 1916 between armies of Kingdom of Italy and Austria-Hungary. The Austro-Hungarian army was primarily made up of regiments filled with Hungarians and Slovenians. The battle was a part of the sixth battle of the Isonzo, and occurred in a strategic area of westernmost edge of the Karst Plateau.

zh.s: 1916年8月，意大利和奥匈帝国军队在多贝尔多德拉戈附近交战。奥匈军队主要由匈牙利人和斯洛文尼亚人组成的团构成。这场战斗是伊松佐河第六次战役的一部分，发生在喀斯特高原最西端的战略要地。

en.s: The Battle of Mărășești (6 August 1917 – 3 September 1917) was the last major battle fought by the Central Powers against the Kingdom of Romania and Russia on the Romanian front during World War I. Romania was mostly occupied by the Central Powers, but the Battle of Mărășești kept the northern region of the country free from occupation.

zh.s: 默勒谢什蒂战役于1917年8月6日至9月3日爆发，是第一次世界大战期间中部同盟国在罗马尼亚战线上对罗马尼亚王国和俄国发动的最后一场大型战役。当时罗马尼亚大部分地区已被中部同盟国占领，但这场战役使该国北部仍未沦陷。

en.s: Presidential elections were held in Portugal on 6 August 1923. The Congress of the Republic elected the president in Lisbon instead of the Portuguese people. However the new president Manuel Teixeira Gomes was elected In absentia, meaning that he wasn't present during the election. There were a total of 5 candidates, 2 from the Democratic Party (Portugal) and 3 from the Republican Party (Portugal). Of these candidates, only the 2 Democratic Party (Portugal) members were left in which Manuel Teixeira Gomes won in a landslide victory against old president and party colleage Bernardino Machado.

zh.s: 葡萄牙于1923年8月6日举行总统选举。总统由共和国国会在里斯本选出，而非由葡萄牙民众投票产生。新总统曼努埃尔·特谢拉·戈麦斯在缺席的情况下当选，也就是说，他没有出席选举。共有5名候选人，其中2人来自葡萄牙民主党，3人来自葡萄牙共和党。最终只剩下民主党的两名候选人角逐，曼努埃尔·特谢拉·戈麦斯以压倒性优势击败前总统、党内同僚贝尔纳迪诺·马沙多。

en.t: Estonia is annexed by the Soviet Union
en.s: The Soviet Union, officially the Union of Soviet Socialist Republics (USSR), was a transcontinental country that spanned much of Eurasia from its formation in 1922 until its dissolution in 1991. It was the world's third-most populous country, the largest by area, and bordered twelve other countries. A diverse multinational state, it was organized as a federal union of national republics, with the largest and most populous being the Russian Soviet Federative Socialist Republic (SFSR).

zh.s: 苏联正式名称为苏维埃社会主义共和国联盟（USSR），是一个横跨欧亚大陆的国家，从1922年成立到1991年解体。它曾是世界人口第三多、面积最大的国家，与其他12个国家接壤。苏联是由多个民族组成的联邦国家，由各加盟共和国构成，其中最大、人口最多的是俄罗斯苏维埃联邦社会主义共和国（SFSR）。

en.s: The Battle for Caen (June to August 1944) was a military engagement between the British Second Army and the German Panzergruppe West in the Second World War for control of the city of Caen and its vicinity during the Battle of Normandy. Caen is about 9 mi (14 km) inland from the Calvados coast astride the Orne River and Caen Canal, at the junction of several roads and railways.

en.t: Atomic bombings of Hiroshima and Nagasaki
en.s: On 6 and 9 August 1945, the United States detonated two atomic bombs over the Japanese cities of Hiroshima and Nagasaki, respectively, during the final days of World War II. The aerial bombings killed 150,000 to 246,000 people, most of whom were civilians, and remain the first and only uses of nuclear weapons in an armed conflict.

zh.t: 广岛和长崎原子弹爆炸
zh.s: 1945年8月6日和9日，第二次世界大战末期，美国分别在日本广岛和长崎上空引爆两枚原子弹。空袭造成15万至24.6万人死亡，其中大多数是平民。这是核武器首次、也是唯一一次在武装冲突中被使用。

en.s: The 1957 All-Ireland Senior Camogie Championship Final was the 26th All-Ireland Final and the deciding match of the 1957 All-Ireland Senior Camogie Championship, an inter-county camogie tournament for the top teams in Ireland. Antrim led 2–1 to 0–2 at half-time but Dublin gradually wore them down, Bríd Reid scoring a last-minute winning goal after Eilish Campbell, Antrim's star player, had gone off injured.

zh.t: 1957年全爱尔兰高级卡莫吉锦标赛决赛
zh.s: 1957年全爱尔兰高级卡莫吉锦标赛决赛是第26届全爱尔兰决赛，也是该年度锦标赛的冠军决胜战。这项跨郡卡莫吉赛事由爱尔兰顶级球队参加。半场时，安特里姆以2-1领先都柏林的0-2；此后都柏林逐渐扭转局势。安特里姆明星球员艾利什·坎贝尔受伤离场后，布里德·里德在比赛最后一分钟攻入制胜球。

en.t: Jamaica becomes independent from the United Kingdom
en.s: Jamaica is an island country in the Caribbean, covering 10,991 square kilometres (4,244 sq mi). It is the third-largest island in the Greater Antilles and the Caribbean, after Cuba and the island of Hispaniola. Jamaica lies about 145 km (78 nmi) south of Cuba, 191 km (103 nmi) west of Hispaniola (the island containing Haiti and the Dominican Republic), and 215 km (116 nmi) southeast of the Cayman Islands (a British Overseas Territory).

zh.s: 牙买加是加勒比海岛国，面积10,991平方公里（4,244平方英里）。它是大安的列斯群岛和加勒比地区第三大岛，仅次于古巴和伊斯帕尼奥拉岛。牙买加位于古巴以南约145公里（78海里）、伊斯帕尼奥拉岛以西191公里（103海里；该岛上有海地和多米尼加共和国），以及开曼群岛东南215公里（116海里；开曼群岛为英国海外领土）。

en.t: U.S. president Lyndon B. Johnson signed the Voting Rights Act into law, outlawing literacy tests and other discriminatory voting practices that had been responsible for the widespread disfranchisement of African Americans
en.s: The Voting Rights Act of 1965 is a landmark U.S. federal statute that prohibits racial discrimination in voting. It was signed into law by President Lyndon B. Johnson during the height of the civil rights movement on August 6, 1965. Congress later amended the act five times to expand its protections.

zh.t: 美国总统林登·B·约翰逊签署《投票权法》，禁止识字测试及其他歧视性投票做法

en.s: On August 6, 1966, Zayed Al Nahyan, the younger brother of ruling Sheikh of Abu Dhabi Shakhbut Al Nahyan, staged a bloodless palace coup with direct military assistance from the United Kingdom, then Abu Dhabi's colonial overlord via the Trucial States.

en.s: The Battle of Suối Châu Pha (6 August 1967) was fought during the Vietnam War between Australian troops and the Việt Cộng. The battle took place during Operation Ballarat, an Australian search and destroy operation in the eastern Hát Dịch area, north-west of Núi Đất in Phước Tuy province.

en.s: Operation Gordian Knot (Operação Nó Górdio) was the largest and most expensive Portuguese military campaign in the Portuguese overseas province of Mozambique, East Africa. The operation was carried out in 1970, during the Portuguese Colonial War (1961–1974). en.s: Allan Hills 84001 (ALH84001) is a fragment of a Martian meteorite that was found in the Allan Hills in Antarctica on December 27, 1984, by a team of American meteorite hunters from the ANSMET project. However, it does not fit into any of the previously discovered SNC groups.

en.s: Korean Air Flight 801 was a scheduled international passenger flight operated by Korean Air, from Gimpo International Airport, Seoul to Antonio B. Won Pat International Airport, Guam. On August 6, 1997, the Boeing 747-300 operating the flight crashed on Bijia Peak, south of Nimitz Hill, in Asan-Maina, Guam, while on approach to the destination airport, killing 229 of the 254 people aboard, making it the deadliest aviation accident to occur in American dependent territory, and the fourth-deadliest aviation accident on American soil overall.

zh.s: 大韩航空801号班机是一条定期国际客运航线，往返首尔金浦国际机场和关岛安东尼奥·汪帕特国际机场。1997年8月6日，执行该航班的波音747-300在飞往目的地、进近过程中，坠毁于关岛阿桑-迈纳的比贾峰，地点在尼米兹山以南。机上254人中有229人遇难。这是美国属地发生的死亡人数最多的航空事故，也是美国境内死亡人数第四多的航空事故。

en.s: The 78th Locarno Film Festival took place from 6 to 16 August 2025, in Locarno, Switzerland. Cambodian filmmaker Rithy Panh served as the jury president for the main competition. Japanese drama film Two Seasons, Two Strangers by Sho Miyake was the winner of the Golden Leopard, the festival's main prize. Elsa Kremser and Levin Peter's White Snail was the winner of the Special Jury Prize.

en.s: 2026 Tennessee county mayoral elections were held on August 6, 2026, to determine the mayor (or county executive) of 94 of the 95 counties in the state, including several of the most populous; Shelby, Knox, Hamilton, Rutherford, Montgomery, and Williamson County. Local county primary elections were held on May 5, 2026. The general elections for county mayor were held concurrently with primary elections for various state offices, including the gubernatorial and senatorial primaries.

zh.s: 田纳西州于2026年8月6日举行县级市长（或县行政长官）选举，在该州95个县中的94个县选出地方行政首长，包括人口最多的谢尔比县、诺克斯县、汉密尔顿县、拉瑟福德县、蒙哥马利县和威廉森县。各县初选于2026年5月5日举行。县长普选与州长、参议员等州级公职初选同时举行。
